[ASSISTANT_SAID] Testing of a data warehouse is the process of verifying that the data warehouse is working correctly and that the data it contains is accurate and complete.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Types of tests typically run on a data warehouse include: unit tests, integration tests, performance tests, user acceptance tests, regression tests, and data validation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Unit tests are used to test individual components of the data warehouse.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Integration tests check that different components of the data warehouse work together correctly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Performance tests check that the data warehouse can handle the volume of data it is processing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User acceptance tests check that the data warehouse meets the needs of end users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regression tests check that changes made to the data warehouse do not break existing functionality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Data validation verifies that the data in the data warehouse is accurate, complete, and consistent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, testing of a data warehouse ensures it is working correctly and that the data it contains is accurate and complete.
